SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SP. BR. REGISTRY / No. N. 1437-F/(2) / Date 6 / 8 / 42）

Station. File No. Date
SUBJECT: Procedure to be adopted as regards
reports on change of address, birth or death.

I. Change of address.

Two forms are to be filled in : one is to be kept at
the station concerned and the other form to be for-
warded to the Foreign Pao Chia Office.

Residents changing their addresses will be classified
as follows:
A. Those changing residence in the same Police
District.
Two forms are to be filled in, one
of which will be forwarded by the Station concerned
to the Foreign Pao Chia Office.

B. Those removing into another Police District.

Two forms are to be filled in with full particulars
of the new address. One of the forms will be attached
to the Pao Chia Census Form which will be forwarded by
the station concerned to the Foreign Pao Chia Office
for recording purposes. (The Foreign Pao Chia Office
after having recorded the change of address, will forward
the forms to the Station of the District of new resi-
dence where a new residents certificate will be issued.
The old residents certificate must be taken to the
Station by the person removing in exchange for a new one.

C. Those removing from the Settlement to the French
Concession or the Western Area.

Two forms are to be filled in, one of which with par-
ticulars of the new address to be forwarded to the
Foreign Pao Chia Office. The Foreign Pao Chia Office

主题：关于地址变更、出生或死亡报告所应采用的程序。

一、地址变更。

需填写两份表格：一份由相关警署留存，另一份送交外侨保甲办事处。

变更地址的居民分类如下：
A. 在同一警察辖区内变更住所者。
需填写两份表格，其中一份由相关警署送交外侨保甲办事处。

B. 迁入另一警察辖区者。

需填写两份表格，详细列明新地址。其中一份表格将附于保甲户口调查表上，由相关警署送交外侨保甲办事处以备记录。（外侨保甲办事处在记录地址变更后，会将表格转送至新居住地所属辖区的警署，以便签发新的居住证。搬迁人须持旧居住证前往警署换领新证。）

Having recorded the new address, will forward the forms
to the Police Station having jurisdiction over （批：the） loca-
lity of the new residence.

Those removing from the French Concession or the
Western Area into the Settlement, are required to
fill in the Foreign Pao Chia Census Forms at the
Police Station （批：in which the） of the district where new
residence is located. They will then be issued with
a new residents certificate. THE OLD RESIDENTS
CERTIFICATE WILL BE RETURNED
TO THE STATION.

2. Birth and Death Reports.
（批：making reports of births & deaths）
Forms provided for the purpose are to be filled in
in duplicate. One copy will be retained by the station
concerned, while the duplicate will be forwarded to the
Foreign Pao Chia Office.

3. Monthly Reports.
（批：giving）
Monthly reports containing particulars of the total
（批：as well as the first under 1）
number of persons changing addresses, births and
deaths, are to be forwarded to the Foreign Pao Chia
Office by the Station concerned before the 4th of the
month.

Note.
Temporary Residents Certificates.
（批：may）
Temporary residents certificates will be issued to
persons whose proposed stay in Shanghai will not
exceed the period of two months.

Special Residents Certificates.

Special residents certificates will be issued only to
members of the local Diplomatic Body. These certifi-
cates are issued direct by the For. Pao Chia Office,
ON APPLICATION.

为此目的提供的表格需一式两份填写。一份由相关警署留存，副本送交外侨保甲办事处。

3. 月度报告。
（批注：提供）
包含地址变更人员总数、（批注：以及第一类以下）出生及死亡总数的月度报告，须由相关警署于每月4日前送交外侨保甲办事处。

pages.en:
Procedure to be adopted for reporting change
of address or births or deaths

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
No. N. 1437-F1-(3)
Date...... 6 8 42）

1. Change of address

Two forms are to be filled in : one will be kept
at the Police Station concerned and the other will
be forwarded to the Foreign Pao Chia Office.
Residents changing their addresses will be
classified as follows:

A. Those changing from one residence
to another in the same Police District

Two forms are to be filled in, one of which
will be forwarded by the Station concerned
to the Foreign Pao Chia Office.

B. Those removing into another Police District

Two forms are to be filled in with full
particulars of the new address. One of the
forms will be attached to the Pao Chia Census
Form both of which will be forwarded by
the Station concerned to the Foreign Pao Chia
Office for recording purposes. After recording
the change of address, the Foreign Pao Chia
Office will forward the forms to the Station of
the District into which the resident has moved,
after which a new residents certificate will be
issued. The old residents certificate must be
taken to the station by the person concerned to
exchange it for a new one.

C. Those removing from the Settlement into the
French Concession or the Western Area

Two forms are to be filled in one of which
containing particulars of the new address will
be forwarded to the Foreign Pao Chia Office.
After recording the new address the Foreign
Pao Chia Office will forward the forms
to the Police Station having jurisdiction.

关于报告地址变更或出生、死亡所应采用的程序

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
登记室
编号 N. 1437-F1-(3)
日期...... 42年8月6日）

1. 地址变更

需填写两份表格：一份由相关警署留存，另一份送交外侨保甲办事处。
变更地址的居民分类如下：

A. 在同一警察辖区内从一处住所迁至另一处者

需填写两份表格，其中一份由相关警署送交外侨保甲办事处。

B. 迁入另一警察辖区者

需填写两份表格，详细列明新地址。其中一份表格将附于保甲户口调查表上，两者均由相关警署送交外侨保甲办事处以备记录。外侨保甲办事处在记录地址变更后，会将表格转送至居民迁入辖区的警署，随后签发新的居住证。当事人须持旧居住证前往警署换领新证。

C. 从租界迁往法租界或西区者

需填写两份表格，其中一份载明新地址详情，送交外侨保甲办事处。外侨保甲办事处在记录新地址后，会将表格转送至拥有管辖权的警察局。

pages.en:
(2)
over the locality of the new residence.
Those removing from the French Concession or
the Western Area into the Settlement are
required to fill in the Foreign Pao Chia Census
forms at the Police Station of the District in
which the new residence is located. They
will then be issued with a new residents
certificate. The old Residents Certificate
must be returned to the Station.

2. Births and Deaths
Forms provided for making reports of births
and deaths are to be filled in duplicate. One
copy will be retained by the Station concerned,
while the duplicate will be forwarded to the
Foreign Pao Chia Office.

3. Monthly Reports
Monthly reports giving particulars of the total
number of persons changing addresses as well
as the total number of births and deaths,
are to be forwarded to the Foreign Pao Chia Office
by the Station concerned before the 4th of the
month.

Note
Temporary Residents Certificates
Temporary residents certificates may be issued to
persons whose proposed stay in Shanghai will not
exceed the period of two months.

Special Residents Certificates
Special residents certificates will be issued only
to members of the local Diplomatic Body. These
certificates are issued direct by the Foreign
Pao Chia Office on application.
pages.zh:
(2)
对新居住地拥有管辖权。
从法租界或西区迁入租界者，须在新居住地所在辖区的警察局填写外侨保甲户口调查表。随后将向其签发新的居住证。旧居住证须交回警署。

2. 出生与死亡
用于报告出生和死亡的表格需一式两份填写。一份由相关警署留存，副本送交外侨保甲办事处。

3. 月度报告
提供地址变更人员总数以及出生和死亡总数的月度报告，须由相关警署于每月4日前送交外侨保甲办事处。

注
临时居住证
拟在上海停留不超过两个月者，可获发临时居住证。

特别居住证
特别居住证仅签发给当地外交团成员。此类证书由外侨保甲办事处凭申请直接签发。
